questions.text:
A: "Did you receive our inquiry? When will we receive your confirmation?"
B: "My apology. It seems that ________. Could you possibly resend it?"
questions.explanation: The context implies a past action with relevance to the present (the letter is missing now). The present perfect passive 'has been mislaid' correctly fits this description.

questions.text: _______ a new policy related to the establishment of business was released, entrepreneurs had found it difficult to get a license for their new businesses.
questions.explanation: Until indicates that up to the time the new policy was released, entrepreneurs faced difficulties getting a license.

questions.text:
A: "Excuse me. Could you tell me which bus I should take to get to Plaza Indonesia?"
B: "Sorry, I don’t know. You _________ ask the driver."
questions.explanation: 'Had better' is used to give advice or make a strong recommendation about what someone should do in the present situation.

questions.text: By the time Mr. Arifin retires, his youngest child will have graduated from university. This means that Mr. Arifin ______ when his youngest son graduates.
questions.explanation: Since he retires after his youngest child graduates, he is still working at the time of graduation.

Paragraph 1 give conclusion about paragraph 2 statement

questions.explanation: Cinemagoers refers to people who go to the cinema to watch movies, synonymous with audience or moviegoers.

Attract people to attend to cinema during Coronavirus pandemic
Announce cinema discount all over Korea

questions.explanation: The text states the film industry is ushering people to cinemas with discount coupons despite fears concerning the Coronavirus.

questions.explanation: Plethora means a large or excessive amount of something, similar in meaning to 'many'.

Infecting animals’ intestine and its respiratory system thus infecting human

questions.text: According to the text, how does LIWC help analyze president candidates’ speeches?
options: It does the quantitative analysis, which was later used by psychologists
It helps the psychologist reveal the candidates’ hidden motives
It makes analysis of nouns and verbs used by the candidates during their speeches
It counts how many inappropriate words are used by the candidates
It provides psychological research on the connection of word usage and people’s personality
questions.correctAnswer: It does the quantitative analysis, which was later used by psychologists

questions.text: According to the text, which of the following statements about LIWC is FALSE?
options: The software cannot detect unconscious use of words
The software is able to count certain words and analyze the numbers
By using LIWC, we learn about the characteristics of the US presidential candidates
LIWC’s result confirms that people’s characters affect their word usage
The software works on the basis of the psychologists’ analysis design
questions.correctAnswer: The software cannot detect unconscious use of words
